evals.prompt: Critique this report before I send it to the exec team — the draft is finished, I just want to know what a reviewer would catch first.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Reviews the complete draft and records its type and intended reader; Assigns pass / fix / block to each of the ten base points with a rationale citing the section; Marks the conditional points N/A with a reason where their conditions do not fire; Returns a verdict that follows mechanically from the statuses; Gives every non-passing point a located fix and the condition under which it would pass.
expectations: Reviews the complete draft and records its type and intended reader
Assigns pass / fix / block to each of the ten base points with a rationale citing the section
Marks the conditional points N/A with a reason where their conditions do not fire
Returns a verdict that follows mechanically from the statuses
Gives every non-passing point a located fix and the condition under which it would pass

evals.prompt: The brief is drafted and unsent. Is it ready to publish? I'm worried it has no limitations section and the confidence sounds higher than the evidence supports.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Checks whether limitations are stated and whether stated confidence matches the evidence grade; Flags unsourced load-bearing claims and undefensible numbers; Produces a publish verdict of approve, revise or block.
expectations: Checks whether limitations are stated and whether stated confidence matches the evidence grade
Flags unsourced load-bearing claims and undefensible numbers
Produces a publish verdict of approve, revise or block

evals.prompt: Run a structured self-review over my whole 12-page draft: does it actually answer the question that was asked, is the method reproducible, has counter-evidence been engaged, and are the next steps owned and dated?
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Walks the fixed point list rather than commenting impressionistically; Names the strongest disconfirming evidence the draft failed to engage; Requires owner and date on the recommended next actions.
expectations: Walks the fixed point list rather than commenting impressionistically
Names the strongest disconfirming evidence the draft failed to engage
Requires owner and date on the recommended next actions

evals.prompt: Just take our single headline conclusion and attack it the way a hostile competitor's analyst would — definitions, baselines, counter-examples.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Attacks one claim along the named vectors and returns a survival score and verdict; Does not audit the whole document's structure, sourcing and next actions.
expectations: Attacks one claim along the named vectors and returns a survival score and verdict
Does not audit the whole document's structure, sourcing and next actions

evals.prompt: Check that every DOI, arXiv ID and URL in the reference list is well formed and resolves before this goes out.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Validates citation identifiers against their canonical formats and flags broken ones; Does not run a document-wide pass/fix/block review.
expectations: Validates citation identifiers against their canonical formats and flags broken ones
Does not run a document-wide pass/fix/block review
